name: @leafypay/mongo-compat
description: Which MongoDB deployment this is (Atlas, Enterprise Advanced or Community Edition, and which version), the full capability set that implies (Queryable Encryption automatic/range/text-search, change streams, time series, Atlas Search, audit log), crypt_shared library resolution, and which setup commands apply. The single source of truth, shared by every service (PSP, bankcore, GIAM) as an identical vendored copy.
